description:
Position Overview

The Chair of Strategic Management and Innovation (SMI) at ETH Zurich invites applications for a PhD Position in Management and Organization Research: AI in Strategic Management. This is a 100%, fixed-term doctoral position in Zurich, advertised on the chair's official open positions page.

The doctoral researcher will study how artificial intelligence reshapes strategic management and organisations - for example how firms adopt AI technologies, how AI changes competitive dynamics and decision-making, and the organisational consequences of AI deployment.

Research Areas

  • AI adoption and value creation in firms
  • Strategic management and organization theory
  • Innovation, technology strategy and competitive dynamics
  • Empirical research methods for management research

How to Apply

Follow the application instructions on the official SMI open positions page (application documents typically include CV, transcripts, a research statement and reference contacts). Early applications are strongly recommended because positions are filled as suitable candidates are found.

About the SMI Chair

The Chair of Strategic Management and Innovation at ETH Zurich (led by the Department of Management, Technology and Economics, MTEC) conducts research on strategic management, innovation and the economics of technology, with a strong empirical orientation and an international research environment.
